text.name: Sanctions Wall
text.rules: Record "reserves frozen". LIO spends 3 points. At the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: After Russia's invasion of Ukraine on 24 February 2022, Western governments froze about $300 billion of Russian central-bank reserves and, from 12 March 2022, cut seven Russian banks off from the SWIFT payments network.
